title: One Deflate decoder per OOXML open, above a measured member threshold
decision: retained after a held revision; ZIP-1 of the 0587 queue implemented for the structural admission pass and the serial batch wave, gated by SESSION_MEMBER_THRESHOLD
reason_codes: the open's structural admission pass built one DeflateDecoder per member: 41 and 20 constructions of 80,320 bytes removed on the two above-threshold fixtures, 58.95% and 73.02% of the open's allocated bytes

the first implementation kept the session for every package and regressed docx_file_source_open; the regression is attributed to +8 minor page faults per fresh-process open (92 -> 100 at p50 and every quantile, 150 interleaved runs per leg), caused by the retained 80,320-byte workspace raising the open's heap high-water

instructions and cycles were not the cause: callgrind showed -7.38% Ir per open on that corpus, perf stat -0.81% instructions and +0.31% cycles, and syscr/rchar were byte-identical, so the RefCell borrow, the decoder reset, inlining and I/O are all ruled out

a threshold of 16 relationship members, decided from the count source_catalog already computes for its RelationshipParts limit and passed through a new default-no-op ArchiveAccess hook, removes the regression: the same instrument now shows +0.9 minor faults and +2.45% p50 on that corpus, while the 445-member PPTX keeps +2.11% p50 and the 132-member workbook 4.88-5.34% p50 against a 0.14% floor
a first version of the threshold that scanned member names inside the wrapper cost +4.83% cycles and +659% cache misses per open on the 20-member DOCX and was replaced, not kept

the harness ABBA on the retained implementation puts docx_file_source_open's adverse direction at -0.20% and -0.74% against floors of 5.52% and 7.61%, and pptx_file_source_open favourable in all four directions (+2.76% to +5.50% p50 against floors of 3.12% and 3.22%)

accepted_evidence.counts: exact allocation, allocated-byte, positional-request and version()-call counts for open, first and second part read, all parts in both physical orders, stream_to and a serial read_parts_ordered wave, on three real OOXML fixtures, both legs
accepted_evidence.instructions: callgrind self-cost tables for open plus one part on the 132-member workbook, and a 20/40 isolation pair of the DOCX open used for the attribution
accepted_evidence.cycles: perf stat 100/200 isolation pairs, -r 5, all counters at 100% coverage, for the DOCX corpus (below the threshold) and the PPTX corpus (above it)
accepted_evidence.resource: minor page faults per fresh-process open from the selector's own --filesystem-child /proc deltas, 150 and 120 interleaved runs per leg, on both corpora and both implementations
accepted_evidence.timing: interleaved paired child measurements alternating leg by sample; an in-process ABBA of the open through the probe on two real fixtures; and A1 B1 B2 A2 harness runs of docx_file_source_open, pptx_file_source_open and xlsx_source_open with an A/A floor in each window
accepted_evidence.correctness: a corpus-wide differential over 179 OOXML packages and 4,215 members that asserts both sides of the threshold are exercised (15 with a session, 164 without), a dedicated threshold test, and a by-name session test covering a refused member and the FileNotFound identity

accepted_costs.reach: the threshold limits the change to packages with at least 16 relationship members: 15 of 179 repository OOXML fixtures (8.4%); the other 164 take a byte-identical pre-change path and nothing is claimed for them
accepted_costs.threshold_scope: 16 is a 16:1 margin over a bounded cost measured on one host with one allocator; another platform would need it re-derived
accepted_costs.peak_transient: an above-threshold package holds one 80,320-byte workspace across the pass, measured as +15 minor page faults per fresh-process open of the 132-member workbook and -2 on the 445-member PPTX
accepted_costs.callgrind_accounting: rep stosb is counted per byte; this record measured the gap directly, -7.38% Ir against -0.81% native instructions and flat cycles on the same operation
accepted_costs.residual_adverse_row: xlsx_source_open is -1.40% and -1.89% at p50 against a 1.71% A/A floor over 200 samples per leg. Its nine-member corpus carries two relationship members, so it is below the threshold and executes the pre-change path on both legs; the residue is code layout in a binary carrying added, unexecuted code, about 0.7 us of a 44 us operation. No further attribution was taken and none is claimed.

known_gaps.cold_single_read: a single cold PartView::data() read still builds one decoder (27 allocations / 86,291 bytes, unchanged); a pooled session needs a self-referential borrow or a hand-rolled inflate loop over flate2::Decompress, and neither is designed here
known_gaps.managed_packages: managed packages keep the one-shot path by policy (change 0402)
known_gaps.parallel_batch: only the serial batch wave takes a session
known_gaps.below_threshold: no packaging below 16 relationship members benefits, including the warm-process case where the held implementation measured favourable on comment.docx

withheld: any speedup claim, any RSS or peak-memory claim, any cold-cache, physical-device, range-source, remote-transport, concurrency-scaling or cross-platform result

provenance.host: AMD EPYC 9R45, 32 cores, 123 GiB, Linux 7.0.0-1012-aws, rustc 1.95.0, valgrind 3.26.0
